## Barnaby Selvarajah — Chief Executive Officer

Appointed 5 April 2023. Nineteen years with the group, previously Chief
Customer Officer.

## Junie Whitlam-Ferreira — Chief Financial Officer

Appointed 12 January 2022. Sponsors the capital envelope and any variance
paper going to the Investment Council.

## Anselm Bergkamp — Chief Operating Officer

Appointed 30 September 2024, joining from a Nordic grocery cooperative.
Executive sponsor of the DC-7 automation programme.

## Talia Nkemdirim — Chief Customer Officer

Appointed 8 August 2023. Owns the Harbourline Primary Shop Index.

## Priyanka Rasmussen — Chief Technology Officer

Appointed 2 May 2021. Leads 640 engineers across three sites: Sydney,
Melbourne and Bengaluru. Executive sponsor of the store systems cutover.

## Standing arrangements

- The executive team meets on Monday mornings, 07:30 AEST.
- Each transformation programme has exactly one accountable executive sponsor.
